name: asva-desktop
description: ASVA - reads Tally, sends bills and reminders on the shop's own WhatsApp.
author: Almmatix

releaseInfo.releaseNotes:
ASVA 2.2.2.

The menu folds away: click the ASVA mark (or Ctrl+B) and the left bar becomes a slim strip of icons, so a small window spends its space on your work. A narrow window folds it by itself.

Three looks under More: Green, Blue and Midnight (dark). The whole app follows your choice.

Fixed: a reminder due today said "22 Oct" on one row and "Today" on the next; the top bar showed Hinglish even in English; reminder batches can now start from 9 AM.

New: if a customer opens your payment link and nothing arrives, ASVA offers them help once, politely, without telling them they were watched. Switch it off in Settings if you prefer.
